relationships.subject: INT-777
relationships.evidence_quote: Perisciatic nerve administration of the TGR5 agonist, INT-777 according to a prevention protocol (50 μg/μL daily from postoperative day [POD] 0 to POD6) provided sustained relief from mechanical allodynia and spontaneous pain

relationships.subject: INT-777
relationships.evidence_quote: The results indicated that CCL3, CXCL9, TNF-α, and IL-6 increased in the injured nerve site after pSNL, and the administration of 50 μg/μL INT-777 prevented their upregulation

relationships.subject: TGR5
relationships.evidence_quote: whereas the expressions of ASC, Caspase-1, and IL-1β were significantly upregulated by TGR5 knockdown

relationships.subject: myeloid TGR5 knockdown
relationships.evidence_quote: Cytometric bead array analysis indicated that the expression of CCL2, CCL3, TNF-α, and IL-6 was significantly upregulated in the shGPBAR1 group

key_findings: TGR5 is upregulated in injured nerve and colocalizes with macrophages; agonist INT-777 relieves allodynia and reduces TNF-a, IL-6, CCL3
Myeloid TGR5 knockdown worsens pain and raises inflammatory mediators, ASC, Caspase-1, IL-1b but not NLRP3
